newsitem.title: USA: Duke to shut 1,129 MW nuke for maintenance.
newsitem.headline: Duke to shut 1,129 MW nuke for maintenance.

text.p: Duke Power Co will shut its 1,129 megawatt McGuire nuclear power unit 1 later this week for an expected 100 days for extensive maintenance, a company spokesman said Monday.
The unit, located at Cornelius, North Carolina, will shut later this week to replace a steam generator, spokesman Rick Zuercher said.
A spokesman with the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Duke has filed with the federal agency to shut the unit on Feb 14 and has set a tentative restart date of May 15, 1997.

McGuire unit 2 was operating at 100 percent of capacity as of early Monday, the NRC said in its daily plant status report. The adjacent 1,129 megawatt McGuire nuclear power unit 1 was also operating at full power, the NRC said.
